results.recirculationBlurb: And back to Zuckerberg: David writes that The Social Reckoning is a bit of a mess—and is missing the stuff that made The Social Network unforgettable. It is mostly, he writes, “a long and drawn-out ‘Told ya so!’”

questions.questionText: The director Aaron Sorkin was reportedly shocked when Jesse Eisenberg chose not to reprise what role in this year’s sequel to a 2010 film?
questions.hintText: Jeremy Strong got cast in The Social Reckoning.

questions.questionText: Mark Zuckerberg went with blue for Facebook’s branding because he has deuteranopia—a form of what condition?
questions.hintText: “Blue is the richest,” he said. “I can see all of blue.”

questions.questionText: What fast-paced game released a special deck in 2017 to help players who have color blindness tell the red, yellow, blue, and green cards apart?
An Uno spin-off game known in Europe as Uno Zero—in which players try to get the lowest score over nine rounds—invokes what sport in its U.S. name?
questions.hintText: Play two games for the full experience.

questions.questionText: In golf, finishing a hole one stroke under par scores a birdie; two under par, an eagle; and three under par, what soaring seabird?
questions.hintText: Or find it around the neck of a mariner.

questions.questionText: The world’s largest albatross breeding colony is on what Pacific atoll that, fittingly, about splits the distance between Tokyo and San Francisco?
In 1949, what U.S. city renamed an airport to honor the Battle of Midway shortly before renaming its other major airport for an Irish American war hero?
